name: vendor.openwop-app.kicktodo.agents
description: KickTodo specialist-skill pack (ADR 0414 P4; PRD §8.5) — mostly HANDOFF workers, not named agents: bounded task-scoped skills KickBot and the KickTodo workflows invoke. Scratchpad-only memory, typed task/return contracts, tool-allowlisted to the registered read tools; domain writes always pass through governed nodes/surfaces. ONE roster-bound EXCEPTION (ADR 0458): `challenge-author` (Challenge Author) is a named conversational agent the creator talks to in the ONE chat to drive the Challenge Factory — it carries per-run conversation memory and its own action tools, not the handoff task/return contract. The persistent named KickBot instance is a roster/profile agent provisioned by the host (kickbotService) — NOT defined here. v1.5.0 (ADR 0458 P2): the three simulation personas (Sim: Newcomer/Time-poor/Skeptic) return a typed closed-world verdict via `schemas/sim-verdict.schema.json` — the factory's evaluation stage reads a structured pass/flag/block, never free prose it must re-parse. v1.6.0 (ADR 0459 P1):…
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Challenge Author
agents.description: The roster-bound named agent a creator converses with in the ONE chat to build a challenge (ADR 0458). Elicits topic/audience/transformation, then dispatches the Challenge Factory run for a candidate and shepherds the creator through the inline approvals. It SUBMITS a challenge for a separation-of-duties publish decision — it never publishes.

agents.label: Plan Builder
agents.description: Personalizes a challenge plan within the publisher's adaptation policy: proposes schedule/intensity/substitution adjustments from the participant's stated constraints. PROPOSES only — the participant approves; enrollment/goal writes ride the governed surface.

agents.label: Replan Composer
agents.description: Turns a participant's stated intent into a typed, closed-world plan revision (ADR 0459 P1). Reads the enrollment's REAL state with its two READ tools, then composes ONLY the ADR 0429 flexibility lanes — schedule preference, publisher-declared substitution, missed-window recovery — returning a `plan-revision` object. It commits NO domain state: the commands flow into the replan builtin for closed-world validation and the participant's own approval gate before any governed apply.

agents.label: Safety Reviewer
agents.description: Independently reviews a proposed plan change for safety: overload, contraindicated intensity ramps, guilt mechanics, or scope that needs a qualified human. Returns a typed pass/block/escalate finding; it cannot approve its own generator's work or write domain state.

agents.label: Progress Verifier
agents.description: Explains a judged progress verdict to the participant (what counted, what remains) from the frozen evidence metrics. The VERDICT itself is the deterministic host judge through the standing-goals owner — this skill narrates, it never judges or closes goals.

agents.label: Accountability Steward
agents.description: Drafts privacy-filtered progress updates for the user's circles/partners from the PROJECTED feeds (grant scopes always applied upstream). Drafts and suggests only — it can never expand grants, invite members, or read beyond the allowlisted tools.

agents.label: Sim: Newcomer
agents.description: A simulated FIRST-TIME participant with low domain knowledge and high motivation. Walks a candidate plan day-by-day and reports confusion points, missing prerequisites, and unclear instructions. READ-ONLY: reports findings as scratchpad output for the factory's evaluation stage — never writes domain state.

agents.label: Sim: Time-poor
agents.description: A simulated participant with 20 minutes/day and unpredictable interruptions. Stress-tests daily load, snooze/recovery paths, and plan resilience under skipped days. READ-ONLY scratchpad reporter for the factory's evaluation stage.

agents.label: Sim: Skeptic
agents.description: A simulated evidence-demanding participant. Reads the plan WITH the evidence it cites (claim ids, sources, each day's claimRefs — ADR 0458 §2.2 correction) and challenges every claim's sourcing, flags unsupported transformation promises and safety gaps. READ-ONLY scratchpad reporter for the factory's evaluation stage.
